##### Project general facts

Timez by Danube Properties is a landmark residential development that combines contemporary architecture with timeless elegance. Characterized by its sleek design and shimmering glass façades, the project creates a striking presence on the skyline while offering a sophisticated urban lifestyle. The development features a collection of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, including innovative convertible apartments that can adapt to changing lifestyle needs. By blending smart functionality with refined aesthetics, Timez delivers a modern living experience focused on flexibility, comfort, and long-term value.

The project offers an extensive range of lifestyle amenities designed to create a resort-inspired environment within the city. Residents can enjoy private pools, beautifully landscaped green spaces, open-air lounges, and wellness-focused facilities that promote relaxation and well-being. Thoughtfully designed communal areas encourage social interaction and foster a vibrant community atmosphere, while leisure and recreational amenities provide opportunities for both active and tranquil living. The combination of luxury facilities and carefully curated outdoor spaces transforms Timez into a complete lifestyle destination rather than simply a residential address.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, emphasizing elegance, functionality, and contemporary design. Each residence is thoughtfully planned with smart layouts that maximize space and comfort, while premium finishes enhance the overall living experience. The apartments include fully equipped kitchens with appliances and are delivered fully furnished, providing a turnkey solution for residents. The combination of sophisticated interiors, quality craftsmanship, and flexible living spaces creates homes that are both stylish and highly practical for modern urban lifestyles.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Silicon Oasis is a dynamic and fully integrated community that seamlessly blends residential, commercial, and technological innovation. Strategically located along Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, it provides easy access to key areas in Dubai, including Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport. As one of Dubai's most prominent free zones, it serves as a hub for technology-driven businesses, startups, and multinational corporations.

Designed as a self-sufficient smart city, Dubai Silicon Oasis offers a balanced lifestyle with beautifully landscaped residential neighborhoods, high-tech commercial spaces, and state-of-the-art infrastructure. The area is home to various residential options, including modern apartments, townhouses, and family-friendly villas, making it an attractive destination for professionals and families alike.

Residents and visitors benefit from a comprehensive range of amenities, including reputable schools, healthcare centers, shopping destinations, and recreational facilities. Parks, sports complexes, and fitness centers contribute to an active and healthy lifestyle. Dubai Silicon Oasis stands out for its innovation-driven ethos and forward-thinking urban design, positioning it as a leading destination for living, working, and technological advancement.
